scope: SC04 saved draft/active file compatibility; native Privacy374 independently handled by R2. No product writes or test runs in this review.
finding: Inner ExplorationBoundary v2 alone does not force old-reader refusal. Old draft checks candidate/draft equality, not supported version; old active flat validator checks activation/name/scope/digest without exact supported version. A matching self-consistent new payload can therefore reach old interpretation.

routes.route: loadBoundaryReviewContext prefers readProjectReadAuthoring; otherwise reads generated draft, lock, progress and recommended candidate.
routes.old_refusal_hook: boundary-candidate.ts recommendedBoundaryReviewCandidate accesses draft.pack.resources at23. A file envelope without top-level pack cannot be treated as a flat draft.

routes.route: readBoundaryReviewProgress independently loads native then saved progress; current old16f uses strict parseStoredReadReviewProgress.
routes.constraint: Retain native/progress version fences and exact draft identity; no synthesized confirmations, defaults or migration.

routes.route: readOptionalExplorationDraft and activation fallback draft; loadActivatedExplorationBoundary/Boundaries prefer native, then registry; ENOENT-only fallback to legacy flat active.
routes.old_refusal_hook: old16f validateActivatedExplorationBoundary3214 rejects missing top-level activation.state; registry3261 checks exact outer ACTIVE_EXPLORATION_BOUNDARY_SET_VERSION.

routes.route: Generated draft write, legacy selected-active mirror and full active registry write.
routes.constraint: All new serialized outputs must carry coherent incompatible format. Do not leave a downgraded flat active mirror old code can adopt.

routes.route: Ask profile/authority raw draft and registry/legacy readers.
routes.constraint: Strict registry version hardcoded v1 and direct flat activation lookup need shared decoder; cannot treat unsupported new authority as missing/unknown and continue with stale prior authority.

routes.route: boundary-rescan, boundary-review-mutation/policy, config-inspect, control-policy-project-migration, guided-action, local-ui and protect-query read generated draft or active artifacts.
routes.constraint: Audit direct readers/serializers into one owned file-format codec. Snapshot/hash/existence-only readers need not unwrap; any authority/meaning consumer does. No broad mechanical rewrite or default payload.

proposed_minimum.draft_flat: Existing file path, strict versioned outer envelope with unchanged payload under boundary. Do not duplicate legacy top-level pack/activation. New decoder supports only intended exact version/keys.
proposed_minimum.active_flat: Same principle: versioned outer envelope without legacy top-level activation; preserve inner actual activation digest/receipt, do not manufacture it.
proposed_minimum.active_registry: Bump existing registry discriminator that old code already validates, validate every member coherently before returning any selected authority; no skip/partial acceptance.
proposed_minimum.native: Keep Privacy374 native discriminator; native-first paths otherwise can mask new flat artifacts. Mixed-state contract must be tested explicitly against actual new writer custody.
proposed_minimum.authority: Existing B64 necessary typed-format refusal permission is sufficient for a prospective file serialization envelope in existing locations; no new evidence store or semantic meaning accepted. No reading/resaving old records to upgrade.

presealed_controls.target: New ordinary generated unconfirmed v2 draft, no native/progress masking
presealed_controls.oracle: Cold old supported loadBoundaryReviewContext refuses; original file bytes and absence of progress/native writes preserved. New reader loads disabled/unconfirmed only.

presealed_controls.target: New ordinary saved native v2 + generated file
presealed_controls.oracle: Old native-first load refuses rather than ignoring new protocol or recovering flat compatibility projection; new load retains exact native identity/history.

presealed_controls.target: Actual reviewed/activated new file output from supported path
presealed_controls.oracle: Cold old active legacy loader refuses wrapper; new reader validates actual payload digest/receipt/currentness. Positive fixture must use genuine activation evidence, never fabricated actor/digest.

presealed_controls.target: New registry + valid older legacy active file
presealed_controls.oracle: Old registry version failure is not ENOENT and cannot fall back to old selected active. Both files unchanged; no runtime authority selected.

presealed_controls.target: Mixed member versions/new registry, selected valid member plus unknown/old member
presealed_controls.oracle: New loader refuses entire registry, even if incompatible member is unselected; no implicit normalization, pruning or selected-only acceptance.

presealed_controls.target: Malformed/unknown wrapper, duplicate top-level legacy projection, wrong inner version
presealed_controls.oracle: New strict codec refuses prior to authority use; no inner-only fallback or silent overwrite. Legacy positive loading remains only if explicitly authorized, not inferred.

presealed_controls.target: Native-first coexistence old record plus new file or old registry
presealed_controls.oracle: Record exact authoritative custody; new writer emits consistent v2 native/file state. No claim universal old-reader refusal if it legitimately never reads the new file; classify uncovered mixed provenance instead of manufacturing PASS.

presealed_controls.target: Cold process public review/runtime entry with rejected artifacts
presealed_controls.oracle: Capture original bytes/hashes, repository epoch/pointers and operations before/after; zero resave/activation/source/model calls. Low-level JSON.parse returning an object is not supported-loader acceptance.

limits: Source predicts wrapper refusal; actual old-process test remains required before SC04 closes.
Main owns codec/loaders; Privacy auto-boundary source-production edits require coordinated custody.
No boundary payload digest migration, authority union or missing-review default authorized.
